description: B-1193 Return to Room path (Mike, 2026-11-15: the host decides what follows a networked co-op mission). A listen host and one client start co-op Defection; after 40 s the host fails the mission (--debug-end-mission 40:fail). Each machine shows only its own results; the host moves right from its default Retry Mission to Return to Room and presses it, which sends SVC_MISSION_RETURN: the client leaves its results for the Room, as the host does. Asserts the host's choice, the client's return, each machine's Room opening after it, and that no mission starts again.

input_sequence.comment: Each process runs its own schedule (smoke_path); this one only bounds the test.

required_lines: BOOT: --host-autostart firing: mode=1 stage='base:defection' difficulty=0 anti_client=255 scenario=0 timelimit=0 sims=0
PLAYER.INIT.COMMIT lobby-start room=\d+ mode=1 players=2 bots=0 manifest=[1-9]\d*
NET: ready gate .*2/2 ready 0 declined timed_out=0 .*starting countdown
NET: starting co-op stage 0x[0-9a-f]+ difficulty 0 with 2 players
PLAYER.INIT.COMMIT coop-stage players=2 bond=0 coop=1 anti=-1
SPAWN.ORCH: prepare player=0 client=0 role=bond pool=\d+ duplicate=0
SPAWN.ORCH: prepare player=1 client=1 role=coop pool=\d+ duplicate=0
SPAWN.ORCH: commit player=0 pool=\d+ pos=\([^)]+\) room=\d+
SPAWN.ORCH: commit player=1 pool=\d+ pos=\([^)]+\) room=\d+
NET.STAGE.REPLICATION phase=waiting epoch=[1-9]\d* room=\d+ wait_mask=0x00000002 authority_ready=0 reason=coop-stage-start
NET.STAGE.REPLICATION ready authority=server epoch=[1-9]\d* duplicate=0 post_load=1
NET.STAGE.REPLICATION ready client=1 epoch=[1-9]\d* room=\d+ duplicate=0 post_load=1
NET.STAGE.REPLICATION phase=release epoch=[1-9]\d* room=\d+ ready_mask=0x00000002 authority_ready=1
NET.STAGE.REPLICATION baseline=queued epoch=[1-9]\d* room=\d+ flags=0x[0-9a-f]+ bytes=[1-9]\d*
